title: Chapter 1: A Scandal in Bohemia and Irene Adler
chineseTitle: 第 1 章：波希米亚丑闻与艾琳·艾德勒

paragraphs.en: To Sherlock Holmes she is always THE woman. I have seldom heard him mention her under any other name. In his eyes she eclipses and predominates the whole of her sex. It was not that he felt any emotion akin to love for Irene Adler. All emotions, and that one particularly, were abhorrent to his cold, precise but admirably balanced mind. He was the most perfect reasoning and observing machine that the world has seen, but as a lover he would have placed himself in a false position.
paragraphs.zh: 对于歇洛克·福尔摩斯来说，她永远是“那位女人”。我很少听到他用任何其他名字提到过她。在他的眼中，她遮蔽并主导了她的整个性别。这并不是说他对艾琳·艾德勒感到任何类似于爱的感情。所有的情感（特别是那一种）对于他冰冷、精确但令人赞赏的平衡头脑来说都是令人厌恶的。他是世界所见过的最完美的推理与观察机器，但作为爱人，他会把自己置于虚假的位置。

paragraphs.en: One evening in March 1888, a tall, masked gentleman arrived at 221B Baker Street. He introduced himself as Count Von Kramm, but Holmes instantly exposed him as Wilhelm Gottsreich Sigismond von Ormstein, hereditary King of Bohemia! The King confessed that five years earlier, while a Crown Prince in Warsaw, he had been involved in a passionate romance with Irene Adler, a famous American opera singer.
paragraphs.zh: 1888 年 3 月的一个晚上，一位高大戴着面具的绅士来到了贝克街 221B 号。他自我介绍为冯·克拉姆伯爵，但福尔摩斯立刻揭穿他正是威廉·哥特斯莱希·西吉斯蒙德·冯·奥姆斯坦（波希米亚的世袭国王）！国王承认五年前当他在华沙做皇太子时，曾与著名美国歌剧女歌手艾琳·艾德勒卷入了一场热烈的罗曼史。

paragraphs.en: Now engaged to marry a young Scandinavian princess, the King was terrified that Irene Adler would publish a incriminating photograph of them together to ruin his wedding. Having failed to steal the photograph through burglaries, the King hired Holmes to recover it. Disguising himself first as an out-of-work groom and later as a kindly clergyman, Holmes tracked Irene to her home at Briony Lodge.
paragraphs.zh: 如今与一位年轻的斯堪的纳维亚公主订婚，国王极度害怕艾琳·艾德勒会公布一张他们俩在一起的有罪照片来毁掉他的婚礼。在通过盗窃偷取照片失败后，国王雇佣福尔摩斯收复它。首先把自己伪装成失业的马夫，后来伪装成和蔼的牧师，福尔摩斯追踪艾琳到了她在布里奥尼小屋的家。

paragraphs.en: Holmes staged a fake street fight outside her house, pretending to be injured, and was carried into her sitting-room. Watson threw a smoke-rocket through the window, shouting 'Fire!' In the panic, Irene instinctively rushed to a secret panel behind a picture to save her most precious treasure—the photograph! Holmes marked the secret hiding place, intending to return with the King next morning.
paragraphs.zh: 福尔摩斯在她房子外上演了一场假街头打斗，假装受伤，被抬进了她的客厅。华生通过窗户扔进烟雾火箭，喊着“着火了！”在恐慌中，艾琳本能地冲向一幅画后面的秘密暗格去救她最宝贵的珍宝——那张照片！福尔摩斯标记了秘密隐藏地点，打算第二天早上和国王一起回来。

paragraphs.en: However, when Holmes and the King arrived the next day, they found the house deserted and Irene gone for Europe with her new husband! In the secret panel, Irene had left a letter explaining that she had seen through Holmes's disguise, but promised to keep the photograph safe without exposing the King. She left a portrait of herself, which Holmes kept as his only reward. From that day on, Holmes never mocked women's intellect again.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，当福尔摩斯和国王第二天到达时，他们发现房子空无一人，艾琳已经和她的新丈夫前往欧洲了！在秘密暗格里，艾琳留下一封信解释说她已经识破了福尔摩斯的伪装，但承诺保持照片安全而不曝光国王。她留下了自己的一幅肖像画，福尔摩斯将其留作自己唯一的报酬。从那一刻起，福尔摩斯再也没有嘲笑过女性的智力。
